name: XDKNet 3.0.3.3
body:
XDKNet 3.0.3.3 makes skipping through a show or film faster. Update the
server plugin to 3.0.3.3 along with the app.

## Faster skipping

- Pressing skip several times in a row moves the time straight away and
  asks the server once, instead of once for every press. A single press is
  as quick as before.
- Skips land within a second of where you asked, on the nearest frame that
  can be shown straight away, so the picture comes back sooner. Resuming,
  chapters, skipping intros, SyncPlay and Watch Party stay exact.
- On a fast, steady connection, playback starts again after half a second
  of video instead of a whole second.
- Skipping back a few seconds starts at once on most TVs: the last 15
  seconds are kept within the same memory as before. Low-memory devices,
  such as the Fire TV Stick, keep working as they did.
- Both of the last two can be turned off in Video Playback settings, and
  Playback Information shows what is in use.
- Skipping back from picture-in-picture uses your skip-back length.

## Server

- A new Streaming section under XDKNet's admin settings shows how Jellyfin
  transcodes and offers to put back Jellyfin's own defaults, which convert
  the whole title ahead and keep it for the viewer, so skips land on what is
  already converted. It asks first and can be undone.
- While someone plays a file directly, the plugin reads the next part of it
  into the server's memory so a skip forward doesn't wait on a slow or
  sleeping disk. Network and cloud drives are left alone unless you allow
  them, and it steps back when memory is short.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the Android TV APK below.
